summary: I couldn't find a live Northern Health HARP psychologist ad today. The only HARP posting I found (a LinkedIn ad) looks like an old 2023 one, so check nh.org.au/careers directly. The best open leads are senior and community mental health roles at Northern Health, Austin and Eastern Health, and several of these are listing pages or aggregator copies, so confirm each is still open.
profile: Endorsed Clinical Psychologist (general registration + clinical endorsement)
15+ years across community mental health, acute inpatient and complex care
2.5 years as Senior Practice Leader, so Grade 3/4 and senior clinician roles are in range
Public health, community mental health, private multidisciplinary allied health
Anxiety, depression, OCD, trauma, severe and persistent mental illness, chronic and complex health needs
Eltham base, north and north-east preferred; targeting Northern Health HARP

jobs.title: Clinical leadership and professional governance role, Mental Health units (listed under Senior Clinical Psychologist)
jobs.why: This senior role at your target employer combines advanced clinical practice with governance across the mental health units, which suits your Senior Practice Leader background. The link is a SEEK results page, so open the ad to confirm the discipline and closing date.

jobs.title: Mental Health Clinician: assessment, treatment and case management for adults with serious and complex mental illness (community)
jobs.why: The work is severe and persistent mental illness in the community, which matches your Neami background, and it's a short commute. I couldn't open the individual ad, so check that psychologists are eligible and what grade it is.

jobs.title: Senior Mental Health Clinician, Alcohol and Other Drugs (Addiction Psychiatry and Toxicology service)
jobs.work_type: Part-time, fixed-term (0.6 FTE, Mon–Wed, to 2 June 2027)
jobs.why: It's a senior, open-to-psychologists role at Northern Health working with co-occurring mental health and substance use, but it's fixed-term and 0.6 FTE, and the copy I found dates from June, so check it's still open.

jobs.title: ICYMHS Clinical Psychologist G4 (Senior Clinical Psychologist, supervision and leadership)
jobs.why: It's a senior supervision and leadership role close to home, but it's child and youth focused and only about one day a week, so it would suit as a side role rather than your main one.

jobs.title: Senior Mental Health Clinician, Central Youth Community Team (CYCT)
jobs.why: It's a senior community mental health role for complex presentations in Banyule and Nillumbik, on your doorstep, but it's youth-focused and short-term.

jobs.title: Clinical Psychologist – Grade 2 (Towards Change, Mental Health and Wellbeing Local)
jobs.why: It's a permanent, trauma-informed public community mental health role for adults 26+, but it's Grade 2 (below your seniority), Lilydale is a fair drive, and the ad was last seen in July, so confirm it's still open.

jobs.title: Clinical / Health Psychologist Grade 2, Chronic Pain Service
jobs.why: It's a northern-suburbs community health role in chronic and complex health needs with group and individual work, close to HARP in style, but it's Grade 2 and I couldn't confirm the posting date or that it's still open.

jobs.title: Senior Clinician/Case Manager, Perinatal Emotional Health Service (Grade 3 Clinical Psychologist)
jobs.why: It's a permanent Grade 3 senior clinical psychologist role in a multidisciplinary public team, but it's perinatal-specific, Box Hill is a cross-town drive, and I couldn't confirm the closing date.

jobs.title: Salaried part-time Clinical Psychologist (boutique practice: adult ADHD, anxiety and trauma/EMDR)
jobs.why: It's a salaried private role with paid admin time and leave that suits your anxiety and trauma work, but it's not the public, complex-care or senior setting you're after, and the location isn't confirmed.
